scope: 1,085 reasoning rows; company-scoped reference corpus with category fallback; BM25 + FlashRank
strict_answer_support: Every distinct numeric value in the answer must occur in the same evidence text using normalized numeric equality; numeric substrings do not count. Nonnumeric answers retain normalized text containment.
note: The previous any-one-number metric (top1 0.823 / at5 0.893) is retired. It counted a row as supported when only one of several answer numbers appeared in the evidence.
